name: agent-control-panel
description: Agent City: a local web app for running, chatting with and creating Claude Code subagents across your projects, plus a general Claude chat.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
